issue.description:
ADR-003 records that `cmd_sync_flush_only` hardcodes `CheckpointMode::Monolithic`, so the content-addressed sharded writer required by section 6.1.1 is unreachable and every (now automatic) flush re-serializes a complete monolith — measured at ~6.8x mutation cost at 1610 issues, growing linearly with workspace size. Open beads cover content-addressing the monolithic root and applying tombstones, but none makes the sharded path selectable. Work: decide and wire a mode-selection mechanism (config key or size threshold) in the publication path, prove in sharded mode that object naming dedups identical content and pointer-declared tombstones are applied (including the observed current.json self-listing case), and extend checkpoint round-trip/restore tests to run in both modes.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Make the content-addressed sharded checkpoint mode reachable from sync
